title: Add a device-mode switch
body:
## Spec
Detect TV mode through `?mode=tv` or a recognised TV user-agent hint and expose a `tv` body class. Groundwork only.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `?mode=tv` renders a `tv` class
- [ ] Smart-TV user agents render the same class
- [ ] Mobile remains the default

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Create the 10-foot TV theme
body:
## Spec
Add TV typography, spacing, a dark theme, and safe-area margins without changing mobile mode.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] TV type is readable at distance
- [ ] Content respects TV safe areas
- [ ] Mobile CSS is unchanged

## Dependencies
Depends-on: #1

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Build the spatial focus engine
body:
## Spec
Create a pure JavaScript grid focus function that maps an index and arrow key to the next valid target.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All four arrows work
- [ ] Focus never escapes the grid
- [ ] Node tests cover edges and partial rows

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Wire D-pad navigation to the movie grid
body:
## Spec
Use the focus engine in TV mode so arrows move between film cards and Enter opens the focused film.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] First card receives initial focus
- [ ] Arrow keys use the pure focus engine
- [ ] Enter opens details

## Dependencies
Depends-on: #1, #3

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Replace the TV home grid with rails
body:
## Spec
In TV mode, organise films into horizontal Trending, Watchlist, Science Fiction, and Mystery rails.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] TV mode shows named horizontal rails
- [ ] Mobile keeps the vertical grid
- [ ] Rails use the local API

## Dependencies
Depends-on: #2

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Create the TV detail view
body:
## Spec
Build a full-screen TV film detail with focusable actions and remote-friendly Back/Escape behavior.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] TV detail fills the viewport
- [ ] Actions have visible focus
- [ ] Escape and Backspace return to browse

## Dependencies
Depends-on: #4

## Agent
agent: mock

title: Add the curated rails API
body:
## Spec
Add `/api/rails` returning curated rows for Trending, Watchlist, Science Fiction, and Mysteries.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Endpoint returns stable named rows
- [ ] Every ID exists in the catalog
- [ ] Watchlist rail reflects current state

agent: mock
